core_struggle: An educated professional from a hindi medium background fears being laughed at for their english in meetings and keeps replaying the fear.
mirror: You have the work, and in the meeting you are replaying the words that might come out wrong.

queries.hook: The fear of being laughed at for your english in the meeting, and the replaying of every word that might come out wrong. I feel like an imposter.
queries.diagnose: Fear grows from imagining the future and from forgetting that what is real in us cannot be lost; worry multiplies what has not happened.
queries.steady: What is real in you cannot be taken by their laughter; your worth is not decided by how you speak in a room.
queries.act: Speak the true thing you know, even if the words are not perfect; let the work speak, and let the room hear it.
queries.story: A man of learning who feared his words were not enough, who spoke anyway, and found that the room heard him.

bridge: The fear that your english will be wrong and they will laugh is what the Gita calls fear of loss: imagining a future where they see you as small.
week_thesis: Seven days from fearing the room to speaking in it, with the truth that your worth is not in your english.

week_beats.hook: You recognise the fear of being laughed at in the meeting room, named without judgement.
week_beats.diagnose: You see that the fear is of being seen as less, and that it multiplies what has not happened.
week_beats.steady: You hold that what is real in you cannot be lost by their laughter.
week_beats.act: You try speaking the true thing you know, even if the words are not perfect.
week_beats.story: A man of learning who feared his words were not enough shows you what it looks like to speak anyway.

insight: You know the work. The meeting room is where you replay the words that might come out wrong, and who might laugh.
seat: an educated professional who fears being judged for their english in meetings
life_context: A working professional in their late twenties or early thirties, now in a large company; the fear of being laughed at for their english in meetings keeps replaying, especially after the meeting ends.
details: now works in a large company
fears speaking in meetings because of english
worries others will laugh at mistakes
